description: Delete a post. If it was already published, the platform is told first, and the post is reported deleted only once the platform confirms it is gone; if the platform refuses or is unavailable the call fails with upstream_error and nothing changes, so the same request can simply be retried. If it has not gone out yet, nothing reaches a platform at all: a queued post is cancelled and its quota returned (cancelled_ids), while a draft is simply marked deleted (deleted_ids) and nothing is returned, because a draft never counted against any quota. Deleting a draft returns no quota. A Facebook Page story and any published post on an Instagram account connected by signing in with Instagram rather than through a Facebook Page cannot be deleted through the platform's API, so each is refused with delete_unsupported rather than reported deleted and stays published; it can be deleted in the platform's own app, and chirpie_hide_post keeps it out of the Chirpie listings. THE POST IS NEVER REMOVED FROM CHIRPIE: it keeps its id and its history with status 'deleted', so chirpie_get_post still returns it. Deleting any post of a scheduled thread cancels the whole thread: a thread is published as a unit, so it is cancelled as one. Deleting a published post reaches the platform and cannot be undone; chirpie_hide_post is the reversible alternative, which changes only what Chirpie shows.
name: chirpie_delete_post
title: Delete a post
